observations.limits: No provider delivery, handler monkeypatching or raw tokens retained; each successful credential response is independently checked at protected profile. Distinct token values or sessions are not asserted.

expected.semanticInvariant: A single stored OTP may issue at most one authenticated session across simultaneous valid verification requests.

evidence.concurrency: two overlapping real HTTP requests; no handler interception
